name: Yamaha XSR900
engine: 890 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected
intro: Yamaha's retro-styled triple, on the MT-09 platform. Check the throttle sensor recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2022-2024 XSR900s are in recall 25V248 for the throttle position sensor.
A-002.reason: A failing sensor can cause unstable idle or a stall. The repair is free.

recalls.what: Throttle position sensor can fail, causing rough idle or a stall.
